summary_en: ¥60/share total dividend for FY3/27 (¥30 interim, ¥30 final), up from ¥50/share announced May 13, 2026. ¥10/share increase reflects Q1 operating profit target achievement, stock sales ratio 57.7%, and record cloud/security new monthly bookings. Part of October 2025 capital allocation framework.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: JBCC Holdings announced on July 31, 2026 a dividend increase for fiscal year ending March 2027. The company raised its full-year dividend forecast from ¥50/share to ¥60/share (¥30 interim, ¥30 final), a ¥10/share increase from the prior guidance issued May 13, 2026. The revision reflects strong Q1 results: achievement of the operating profit margin target for the full year, stock sales ratio rising to 57.7%, and record new monthly bookings in the cloud and security segments. The company stated this increase is part of its shareholder return initiatives under the capital allocation framework disclosed in October 2025.
